summary: Rad-e Hoor production plan: prove hearing core (C0), then mechanical vertical slice (C1), then campaign blockout (C2), content (C3), and PC ship prep (C4). No mass final art before C0–C1 clearance. Analysis cites 7 source paths.

deliverables.title: Playtest 1 — echo discrimination (Web Audio)
deliverables.acceptance: 5-minute corridor build with timed logs + CSV; left/right/front/back balanced

deliverables.title: Playtest 3 — hand-in-darkness + 10s window
deliverables.acceptance: Black-screen reachable window interaction; completable without mic

deliverables.title: Playtest 2 — night stealth gray-box
deliverables.acceptance: Shelter + hearing radii prototype on ADR engine or Unity; CPU/audio latency logged

deliverables.title: Document Go/No-Go from tests 1–3
deliverables.acceptance: English report with counts (e.g. 8/12); decision recorded under reports/

deliverables.title: Vertical slice — vehicle shelter
deliverables.acceptance: Breath/normal cabin sound does not Bang; contact vs sound separated

deliverables.title: Vertical slice — plate defense
deliverables.acceptance: Metal plate blocks contact and allows retreat; quiet path remains valid

deliverables.title: Vertical slice — strap rescue
deliverables.acceptance: Camera shows hazard/goal/anchor; reading pause is not hidden punishment

deliverables.title: Vertical slice — three silence paths
deliverables.acceptance: Circle / escape / ledge gray-box reachable; no out-of-pack echoes

deliverables.title: Campaign blockout SE→NW
deliverables.acceptance: Readable path/danger/sound; vehicle 7 + winch placeholders; no illegal companion teleport

deliverables.title: Content integration from screenplay/bibles
deliverables.acceptance: Dialogue/tapes/sheets integrated; E01–E07 only unless approved

deliverables.title: PC ship prep
deliverables.acceptance: Perf on target HW, Steam packaging path, broader playtests documented

risks: Bahram resource balance if slice depends on it
Eleven-chapter scope creep before C0 proof
human_gates: Approve this production plan before executing production tasks
Main engine ADR after C0 signal (or signed exception)
Changes to loop, Bang, or ending rules
